movie.title: Interstellar
movie.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

facts: Get ready for an epic space journey! 'Interstellar' centers on a daring group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to travel through the cosmos.
What's their big mission? They're actually trying to push past the current limitations that hold back human space travel, venturing where no one has gone before.
And the ultimate goal is incredibly ambitious: these explorers aim to conquer the vast, mind-boggling distances involved in traveling between stars!
